error_model.logging: Does not log; relies on Cleanable checks.
raises: RuntimeError if used after cleanup via Cleanable.check_cleaned

side_effects: Mutates current version pointer and versions set

runtime_couplings: Used as a stable dictionary key for spell lineages

dependents.notes: Used by spell binding and system state tracking for lineage identity.

integration_flow: Create SpellIndex with an initial spell version id
Update current version as new spells are promoted
Use SpellIndex as a stable dictionary key

invariants: Hash and equality are based on immutable ULID
Current version pointer can change without breaking dictionary keys
non_goals: Does not validate version ID format
responsibilities: Track current and historical version ids

summary.one_liner: Stable key for spell lineage with mutable current version.
